hooks.command: arch_content=$(cat README.md docs/setup.md docs/architecture.md docs/data-lifecycle.md docs/orchestration.md docs/ml-infrastructure.md docs/observability.md docs/iac.md docs/cicd.md 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$arch_content" ]; then printf '%s' "$arch_content" | jq -Rs '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": ("ARCHITECTURE GUIDE - Always follow README.md and the docs/ files when building. If your changes introduce new components, patterns, data flows, tools, or directory structure, update the relevant file in docs/ (and README.md if the overview changes too).\n\n" + .)}}'; fi

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "ARCHITECTURE REMINDER: Did this change affect the architecture? If you added/changed components, patterns, data flows, tools, or directory structure, update README.md to reflect it."}}'
